2198 Thomas Heywood 1574?-1641 John Bartlett

 
 
 
NUMBER:
2198
 
AUTHOR:
Thomas Heywood
 (1574?–1641)
 
QUOTATION:
Seven cities warred for Homer being dead,
Who living had no roofe to shrowd his head.
 
1
 
ATTRIBUTION:
Hierarchie of the Blessed Angells.
